description: This file contains fuzzing functions for Kubernetes networking API objects, including NetworkPolicyPeer, NetworkPolicy, HTTPIngressPath, ServiceBackendPort, IngressClass, IPAddress, and ServiceCIDR, utilizing the randfill library for fuzzing and generating random IPs and CIDRs.

methods.name: generateRandomIP
methods.description: Generates a random IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) based on the boolean parameter, using random bytes and converting to string.

methods.name: generateRandomCIDR
methods.description: Generates a random CIDR block (IPv4 or IPv6) with a random prefix length, based on the boolean parameter.
